agent.problem: The opening card has four sentences once the standalone "NEXT!" is counted, exceeding the three-sentence limit for an opening card.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences.

agent.problem: Verse 6 has not yet been told, and the earlier cards give no basis for choosing "forever" over "an age." The baker must guess unseen wording rather than reason out the blank's meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The joke says the kings and rulers are called "right after the cattle," but verse 10 places crawling creatures and flying birds between the cattle and the people in verse 11.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.
